description: Thornwick's guards, archer and villagers (members carry faction "village"; P22 moved M5's rules and texts here, plan M6-M9 section 2.12). Neutral until the giant offends them: a direct blow on a member (or, in the world, damage to a faction house) warns; a second within 30 s turns them hostile (or the smashed cart barricade does); intimidation stands the guards down. Its villagers flee from a giant rushing by (civilians_give_way false: the Valley is unchanged).
warn_text: Thornwick's people cower. Strike again and they will fight you.
hostile_text: Thornwick turns on you: its guards will fight.
reconciled_text: Thornwick forgives you, if not the fright.
